Yes, your policy covers mental health, behavioral health, and substance abuse services. Here are the details:

**Outpatient Services:**
- **Office visits:** 10% coinsurance (in-network) or 30% coinsurance (out-of-network)
- **Other outpatient services:** 10% coinsurance (in-network) or 30% coinsurance (out-of-network)

**Inpatient Services:**
- 10% coinsurance (in-network) or 30% coinsurance (out-of-network)
- Inpatient physician fees: 10% coinsurance (in-network) or 30% coinsurance (out-of-network)

**Important Notes:**
- These coinsurance costs apply **after your deductible has been met** ($1,700 individual/$3,400 family for in-network providers)
- You **do not need a referral** to see a specialist, so you can access mental health counseling services directly
- If you have other questions about specific mental health services or limitations, you can contact the plan at (855) 431-5540 or review the complete plan document at go/benefitdocuments
